protocol.signal: completed UTC daily SMA fast/40; enter bear after N bearish days, recover after M non-bearish days
protocol.costs: default 10+5 bps, moderate 20+10 bps, stress 50+25 bps per side
protocol.hard_cap: 2.5X opening control and <=3X observed effective leverage
protocol.selection: worst Research/Validation excess across all costs; OOS excluded
